text: I think you'll really enjoy this Oven Roasted Broccoli recipe. It's a quick and easy side dish that fits within your typical cooking time frame. The ingredients are simple and straightforward, and the addition of parmesan cheese will likely appeal to your taste for savory flavors. Since you tend to prefer recipes with greens, this one is a great match. It's also a relatively healthy option, with a good balance of protein, healthy fats, and fiber, which aligns with the lower sugar content you seem to prefer in your recipes.
